text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is where Falcon and the others were 
the other day—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, just like that! Let's all sing 
together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best, Suzuka-chan! Let's go 
with a "Fight, oh!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Songs have the power to convey feelings. 
So as long as you pour your heart into 
singing your best, you'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"We're definitely going to have even more 
participants today! More girls who want to 
sing their feelings of gratitude 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm certain this live performance 
will be a success too. Without fail...!
The 2nd Live is about to begin!
